name: agy-hud
description: Strictly passive Antigravity CLI status-line HUD

scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/agy-hud.js "--banner:js=#!/usr/bin/env node" && esbuild codex/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node18 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/codex-hud.js "--banner:js=#!/usr/bin/env node"
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run build:test && npm run lint && npm run test:opencode-hud && node --test build/test/*.test.js && node --test build-codex/codex/test/*.test.js
